When did Cambodia gain independence?
Cambodia became independent from France on 9 November 1953. Independence Day is celebrated every year on 9 November.

How many provinces does Cambodia have?
Cambodia has 24 provinces plus the capital, Phnom Penh, making 25 in total. The newest province is Tbong Khmum, created in 2013.

What is the Tonle Sap's special feature?

The Tonle Sap River changes direction twice a year. In the rainy season, the swollen Mekong pushes water up into the Tonle Sap Lake, which grows several times larger; in the dry season, the flow reverses and drains back. The Water Festival celebrates this.

What was Angkor?

Angkor was the capital region of the Khmer Empire from about the 9th to the 15th century, near today's Siem Reap. It had huge temples like Angkor Wat, Bayon and Ta Prohm, and a large water system of reservoirs and canals. It's a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

What are Cambodia's neighbors?
Thailand to the west and northwest, Laos to the north, and Vietnam to the east and southeast. To the southwest is the Gulf of Thailand.

ទន្លេសាបមានអ្វីពិសេស?

ទន្លេសាបហូរបញ្ច្រាសទិសពីរដងក្នុងមួយឆ្នាំ។ នៅរដូវវស្សា ទឹកទន្លេមេគង្គឡើងខ្ពស់ រុញទឹកចូលបឹងទន្លេសាប ធ្វើឱ្យបឹងពង្រីកធំជាងមុនច្រើនដង។ នៅរដូវប្រាំង ទឹកហូរត្រឡប់ចេញវិញ។ បុណ្យអុំទូកប្រារព្ធដើម្បីអបអរព្រឹត្តិការណ៍នេះ។
